{{nihongo|'''Ahita Shrine'''|阿比太神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Settsu Province]].

[[File:Ahita Shrine - DCBVeg0UIAYITuQ.jpg|thumb|250px|right|{{center|Shrine grounds}}]]
'''Ahita Shrine''' (あびたじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} located in Sakuragaoka, {{ill|Minoh|Q665097|qid=Q665097}}, {{ill|Osaka Prefecture|Q122723|qid=Q122723}}. It is identified with '''Ahita Shrine''' of {{ill|Teshima district|Q11633558|qid=Q11633558|lt=Toyoshima District}}, {{ill|Settsu Province|ca|Província de Settsu|cs|Provincie Seccu|de|Provinz Settsu|eo|Provinco Seccu|es|Provincia de Settsu|fa|ولایت ستسو|fr|Province de Settsu|gl|Provincia de Settsu|hak|Settsu-koet|id|Provinsi Settsu|it|Settsu (provincia)|ja|摂津国|ko|셋쓰국|lt|Seccu žemė|nl|Settsu (provincie)|pt|Província de Settsu|ru|Сэтцу (провинция)|simple|Settsu Province|sk|Seccu (provincia)|sr|Провинција Сецу|tr|Settsu (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Сеццу|zh|攝津國|zh_min_nan|Settu-kok|zh_yue|攝津國|qid=Q864163}}, which is listed in the '{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}'. During the {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}}, it was called '''Gozu Tennō'''. {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|Q272993|qid=Q272993|lt=Susanoo-no-Mikoto}} is enshrined as the deity. Since Minoh is a producing area for yuzu citrus, visitors can draw a “yuzu omikuji,” a fortune slip shaped like a yuzu. <ref>[https://spicomi.net/media/articles/2730 Thorough coverage report on weddings and Shinto ceremonies at Ahita Shrine]</ref>

=== History ===
=== Overview ===
According to shrine tradition, it was founded in the 3rd year of {{ill|Emperor Ōjin|Q317997|qid=Q317997}}. In the “{{ill|Engishiki|Q1342448|qid=Q1342448}}” {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Register of Deities}}, compiled in the 5th year of {{ill|Enchō|Q1327274|qid=Q1327274|lt=Enchō}} ({{ill|927|Q30470|qid=Q30470}}), it is recorded as “Ahita Shrine, Major, Monthly and Niiname,” and it was stipulated that offerings would be presented at the imperial court’s {{ill|Tsukinami-no-Matsuri|Q11516161|qid=Q11516161}} and {{ill|Niiname-no-Matsuri|Q11501518|qid=Q11501518}}. Although it is currently enshrined in Sakuragaoka, Minoh City, it is said that the shrine buildings were formerly located north of the present {{ill|Hankyū Minoo Line|Q246334|qid=Q246334}} {{ill|Minoo Station|Q764602|qid=Q764602}}. During the {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}}, it attracted widespread veneration and received {{ill|Hanpei|Q11481885|qid=Q11481885}}.
